title: Keep an annotation attached to its slide through resizing and navigation
preconditions: Save a rectangle on greeting in a review also containing theme.

steps.expected_result: Annotation remains visible and its width relative to slide matches saved normalized width.

steps.action: Select theme, then return to greeting and reload.
steps.expected_result: The mark appears only on greeting in the original relative position.

expected_result: The mark appears only on greeting in the original relative position.
